business_problem: Wipro was maintaining five separate asset-management systems, which created duplication, manual work, and poor lifecycle visibility across hardware operations.
solution_summary: Wipro was maintaining five separate asset-management systems, which created duplication, manual work, and poor lifecycle visibility across hardware operations. Wipro implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around Hardware Asset Management, IT Service Management, CMDB, and Virtual Agent. Key components included Hardware Asset Management centralizes hardware lifecycle workflows; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; CMDB stores service and asset context; Virtual Agent handles conversational self-service. Requests enter through Virtual Agent, and uses context from CMDB before Hardware Asset Management and IT Service Management routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform. Running employee support and operational workflows on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.
